title: Access-gated sign-in surface renders when zeroTrustGate is applied
asA: shelf consumer applying application-admin-console v1.1.0 with zeroTrustGate in the applied capability set
iWant: the sign-in surface to render as Access-gated with no local login form and to read the principal from request.auth
soThat: the admin console composes with edge-cloudflare-access at the sign-in seam and never re-collects credentials in an Access-gated deployment

acceptanceCriteria.description: When application-admin-console v1.1.0 is applied with zeroTrustGate in appliedCapabilities, GET /admin/sign-in renders a region with [data-surface=access-gated], no [data-surface=local-login] region is present, and a [data-role=principal-read] element renders the principal email read from request.auth. The shipped pack check AC-21815-1 on application-admin-console.pack.mjs asserts all three (fires only when zeroTrustGate is in the applied set).
acceptanceCriteria.given: the extended admin-console pack fixture on ?caps=principalDirectory,roleModel,auditLog,zeroTrustGate
acceptanceCriteria.then: the DOM carries [data-surface=access-gated], no [data-surface=local-login], and a [data-role=principal-read] with the request.auth email

acceptanceCriteria.description: When zeroTrustGate is applied but the incoming request lacks request.auth (the JWT validator upstream did not populate it), GET /admin/sign-in refuses with a 403 access-denied surface: no [data-role=principal-read] element is rendered, no principal email is echoed, and no protected data is served. The refusal reason is logged with the correlation id and the applied capability set.
acceptanceCriteria.given: zeroTrustGate applied and a request arrives at /admin/sign-in with request.auth undefined
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response status is 403, the DOM carries the access-denied surface, no [data-role=principal-read] element is present and no protected data is included
